name: Dr. Joel R. Kates, DPM (podiatry)
what_they_do: Solo podiatry and podiatric surgery practice of Dr. Joel R. Kates, DPM, who states more than 40 years in central New Jersey. He recently merged two private practices (Kendall Park and Milltown) into one East Brunswick office at A2 Brier Hill Court, Suite 2.
customers: Adults with foot and ankle conditions, largely older patients and referral/insurance-driven local residents; former Kendall Park and Milltown patients following the move.

size_signals.signal: Sole practitioner; site states over 40 years in practice and a recent consolidation of two practices into one office
Third-party hospital profile still shows the old Milltown and Kendall Park addresses, i.e. a recent relocation

listing.platform: WebMD / Sharecare physician profiles (no Google Business Profile located)

website_review.primary_cta: Only 'Call Us: (732) 545-7078' - no form, no booking
website_review.trust_signals: Only the 'over 40 years in practice' line and the credentials in the header; no photos of the office, no reviews, no insurance list
website_review.out_of_date_signs: The whole site is one screen: a header, a 'WE'VE MOVED!' box and one paragraph. No services, no hours, no map, no navigation. On a 390 px phone the 'WE'VE MOVED' block overflows the right edge so the street and ZIP are cut off ('A2 BRIER HILL COURT ST...', 'NJ 08...')
website_review.search_basics: Weak: page title is 'HOME | Dr. Joel Kates' with no specialty or town, there is no service content to rank, and the only structured data is a WebSite node - no LocalBusiness or Physician markup
top_issues: Effectively no website: one page, no services, no hours, no map, no reviews, no forms
Mobile layout is broken - the relocation notice is clipped off-screen
Recent move leaves conflicting addresses across directories, which is exactly what makes customers and AI agents hesitate
No online booking or enquiry path at all; every new patient must phone

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: one crawlable page and a phone number, but no Google Business Profile found, no hours, an out-of-date third-party listing and no sitemap-linked depth. Answerable: the address and the 40-years claim are the only facts in text - no services, no hours, no insurance, no pricing, and no LocalBusiness/Physician JSON-LD. Bookable: nothing - there is no form, no scheduler and no quote path; an agent can only read out a phone number.

operations_signals.signal: Practice has just merged two offices into one, so patient records, reminders and address changes are all in flux - inference: the phone is handling every reschedule and redirect
No digital intake of any kind; new patients are told to call
Directory listings still carry the previous Kendall Park/Milltown addresses, so patients will arrive at the wrong place unless each listing is corrected

top_opportunities.opportunity: Build a minimal real site: home, services (bunions, heel pain, diabetic foot care, ingrown nails, surgery), hours, insurance, map, and a click-to-call that fits on a phone
top_opportunities.evidence: Current site is a single screen with one paragraph; the 'WE'VE MOVED' block overflows off the right edge at 390 px

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix the address everywhere and claim/complete the Google Business Profile with hours, services and photos, so the relocation stops costing patients
top_opportunities.evidence: Hospital and directory profiles still show Milltown and Kendall Park addresses while the site says Brier Hill Court

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add online appointment requests plus automated reminders and reactivation outreach to patients from the two closed offices
top_opportunities.evidence: No form or booking exists; the practice just consolidated two patient lists into one location

scores.reasons: Gap: the largest in the batch - essentially no website, broken mobile layout, no booking, no structured data. Pay: a solo practitioner 40+ years in, so budget is likely small and may be winding down. Ease: a five-page site plus a corrected Google profile is a one-week job. Evidence: I verified the page contents, mobile clipping, robots.txt and schema directly, but could not find a Google Business Profile or current review count.
